regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad rotation (8 of 16 themes eligible) with Oil & Gas Producers as a crowded, high-durability leader and Gold Miners as the challenger, but the validated edge is only drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate — not return forecasting. Cross-sectional momentum has near-zero rank-IC, so ranks are a focus lens only; the tracker's own direction accuracy (0.343) is below coin-flip and past high-conviction calls have missed, so conviction stays low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (challenger) overtakes Oil & Gas in eligibility and durability while narrowing the 0.502 score margin — a confirmed handoff would be needed before treating gold as the dominant regime.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Leadership concentration is real (rank 1, durable, broad). Trend-gate eligibility is the one validated defensive edge, and XEG.TO remains eligible with trend health (hurst mixed, breadth 0.786) — so the lean is for staying power/avoiding shake-out, not for forecast return. Crowding (z 1.04) is a downsizing caution per guardrails, not a reason to fade.
evidence: trend-gate validated for drawdown control (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Crowding plus mixed hurst tag means momentum can reverse sharply; as the leading crowded theme it is precisely where attention-driven tops form, and ineligible themes would fall out of gate protection.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls below its eligibility gate or lags the S&P/TSX by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Challenger with eligibility and a reasonable durability bar (0.48), though breadth is narrow (0.267). It is the only other scorable theme with positive, eligible leadership and not crowded — the lean is a defensive diversification against oil-led regime concentration, not a return call.
evidence: rotation challenger with margin 0.502 behind leader
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth (0.267) indicates leadership is concentrated in few names and mixed hurst tag weakens persistence; the gold rally can stall without broader participation.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses eligibility or lags XEG.TO by more than 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Mean-reverting hurst tag plus minimal breadth (0.111) suggests current eligible momentum is fragile. The absolute-trend gate is the only real edge, and mean-reversion characteristics imply a shake-out risk that the gate should trim.
evidence: rank 3, eligible: true but hurst_tag mean-revert
theses.dissent: Base metals can have sharp supply-driven rallies unrelated to breadth or durability; mean-revert tag could be wrong if copper breaks out on demand.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO breadth expands above 0.5 while remaining eligible for 10 consecutive sessions

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
